items.name: A. Rivera
items.responsibilities: Owns the DR program: test schedule, Phase 0 sign-off, approval gates during tests (launch flags, teardown), decision log. Named approver in runbook rbk_arpio01.
items.escalation: Escalate to executive sponsor (M. Chen) if unreachable for 15 min during a window

items.name: S. Okafor
items.responsibilities: Vendor-side contact for the recovery tool: replication anomalies, recovery-point alignment questions, launch failures, scope re-selection help. Joins the bridge for the first hour of each test window.
items.escalation: Vendor 24/7 support line with the account id from the password vault

items.name: J. Whitfield
items.responsibilities: Partner-side engineer for the claim switch: sends the live test transaction on game days, confirms allowlist entries for recovery egress IPs, verifies claim responses on the partner side.
items.escalation: Partner NOC (24/7) with the interconnect id; lead time for allowlist changes is 3 business days

items.name: M. Chen
items.responsibilities: Owns the RTO/RPO charter sign-off, funds the program, decision-maker for the orchestration choice (dec_orchestration) and for any real-event failover declaration.
items.escalation: CTO on-call rotation for real regional events
